instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, responsive React full-stack web app displaying the 5 vision board templates with rich interactive detail views.
Implement bilingual FR/EN toggle using a React Context or custom hook.
Ensure persistent favorites storage using the FastAPI backend (/api/favorites).
Use Framer Motion for smooth entrances, tab switching, hover lifts, and modal animations.
Include all required data-testid attributes listed in design_guidelines.json.
Do NOT hide header links in desktop; ensure dark/light mode toggle works flawlessly.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard Vercel dark mode slop.
Provide rich tactile art aesthetics with grain textures, subtle floating badges, and high-contrast typography.
Ensure text contrast adheres to APCA guidelines (minimum 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large display titles).
Ensure interactive components use sonner for notifications when boards are saved or favorited.
